sections.title: باب 7 — متن (39)

paras.text: Baseball is one of the most famous games of the world. It is the national game of America. It is played between two teams, in which every team wins by trying to make more runs than the other team. Every team consists of 9 players, which in every batting period tries to complete as many circuits as possible by reaching all the bases. However, if the fielding side succeeds in getting three players of the opposing team out, the whole team becomes out.

Baseball

Baseball is one of the most famous games of the world. It is the national game of America. It is played between two teams, in which every team wins by trying to make more runs than the other team. Every team consists of 9 players, which in every batting period tries to complete as many circuits as possible by reaching all the bases. However, if the fielding side succeeds in getting three players of the opposing team out, the whole team becomes out.

Field of play

The field of play consists of two parts.

1. In field

2. Out field
